items.story: അടുത്ത വർഷം മുതൽ അമേരിക്കയിലെ എല്ലാ കുട്ടികൾക്കും സ്പേസ് എക്സിന്‍റെ ഓരോ ഓഹരി വീതം സമ്മാനമായി നൽകുമെന്ന് ഇലോൺ മസ്ക് പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു. സ്റ്റാർലിങ്ക്, എഐ ഇൻഫ്രാസ്ട്രക്ചർ എന്നിവയുടെ പിൻബലത്തിൽ 2030-ഓടെ ഒരു ലക്ഷം കോടി ഡോളർ വരുമാനമാണ് കമ്പനി ലക്ഷ്യമിടുന്നത്. വൻകിട നിക്ഷേപകർ വലിയ പ്രതീക്ഷയോടെയാണ് സ്പേസ് എക്സിന്‍റെ ഭാവി വളർച്ചയെ നോക്കിക്കാണുന്നത്.

items.headline: Scientists discover a natural compound that could protect the brain from too much salt
items.teaser: Eating too much salt may do more than raise blood pressure. It could also harm memory and social behavior. In a new study, Japanese resea…
items.story: Eating too much salt may do more than raise blood pressure. It could also harm memory and social behavior. In a new study, Japanese researchers discovered that a soy-derived compound called LPC70 helped protect mice from several damaging effects of a high-salt diet. Mice given the supplement had lower blood pressure, better memory, and improved social interactions compared with mice consuming excess salt alone.

items.headline: Physicists create a bizarre new quantum state called a fractional fermi sea
items.teaser: Physicists have discovered a strange new state of quantum matter in which ultracold atoms defy familiar organizational rules, forming a h…
items.story: Physicists have discovered a strange new state of quantum matter in which ultracold atoms defy familiar organizational rules, forming a highly excited yet surprisingly orderly configuration called a "fractional Fermi sea." The discovery challenges established quantum theories and hints at exotic quasiparticles that scientists have dubbed potential "super-Fermions."

items.headline: Eating blueberries every day may have a surprising effect on your mood
items.teaser: Eating blueberries every day could have surprising effects on mood, according to a small study that found greater reductions in depressiv…
items.story: Eating blueberries every day could have surprising effects on mood, according to a small study that found greater reductions in depressive symptoms among older adults who consumed the fruit for three months. Researchers also detected changes in gut microbial enzymes, suggesting a possible gut-brain connection, although the mood benefits were not statistically significant compared with a placebo.

items.headline: Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish
items.teaser: A psychedelic compound found in magic mushrooms appears to have an unexpected effect: calming highly aggressive fish. Researchers discove…
items.story: A psychedelic compound found in magic mushrooms appears to have an unexpected effect: calming highly aggressive fish. Researchers discovered that low doses of psilocybin significantly reduced aggressive attacks in mangrove rivulus fish without disrupting their normal social interactions. The findings suggest psilocybin may selectively calm escalating aggression rather than simply suppressing all behavior.

items.story: A catastrophic volcanic eruption 7,300 years ago devastated Japan, but new research reveals that its impact on prehistoric populations was far more complex than previously believed. While some communities disappeared or declined, others unexpectedly flourished as survivors migrated, adapted, and found new ways to thrive.

items.headline: Scientists uncover 3 key brain pathways linked to lasting depression relief
items.teaser: Researchers have uncovered three brain pathways linked to lasting improvements in people receiving deep brain stimulation for severe, tre…
items.story: Researchers have uncovered three brain pathways linked to lasting improvements in people receiving deep brain stimulation for severe, treatment-resistant depression. They also discovered that patients who failed to improve after two years shared a striking pattern: insufficient stimulation of a crucial brain connection. The findings suggest that millimeters in electrode placement could make a major difference in treatment outcomes.

items.headline: Two monster black holes could collide in just 100 years
items.teaser: Astronomers have uncovered compelling evidence of two supermassive black holes spiraling toward a potentially spectacular collision at th…
items.story: Astronomers have uncovered compelling evidence of two supermassive black holes spiraling toward a potentially spectacular collision at the center of galaxy Mrk 501. A previously unseen jet of particles revealed the likely presence of a second black hole, with observations suggesting the pair completes an orbit every 121 days. Depending on their masses, these cosmic giants could merge in as little as 100 years.

items.headline: Scientists discover that male and female skin play by different rules
items.teaser: Scientists have uncovered a surprising difference in how male and female skin repairs and renews itself. By tracking individual skin stem…
items.story: Scientists have uncovered a surprising difference in how male and female skin repairs and renews itself. By tracking individual skin stem cells in living mice for five months, researchers discovered that female cells work together in a highly coordinated way, while male cells operate more independently. This synchronization, driven by sex hormones, helps explain why wounds heal faster in female mice, especially during the first few days.
